programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Good Ol' Reno in Gulf Shores, Alabama
programs.desc: A couple searches for a beachfront vacation spot in Gulf Shores, Ala.; they find a house in their dream location, but it needs a new look; with a tight budget and a long list of projects, they try to transform the old home into an updated charmer.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: Mark and his team take on their hardest build ever for their most important client: America's wounded warriors; the guys work side by side with veterans to construct a giant timber frame lodge for Project Healing Waters.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: Mark Bowe returns to the finished homes of some of his favorite "Barnwood Builders" jobs; after months of work, the 100 Cabin, Rose's Cabin, the Boy Scout cabin, and others are living new lives as modern homes.

programs.title: Restoration Road With Clint Harp
programs.desc: A timber-framed Ohio barn from the 19th century is dismantled and rebuilt as a home addition in the small town of Shelby, Ohio.

programs.title: Restoration Road With Clint Harp
programs.desc: Clint heads to a Montana ranch to see how a 270-year-old Dutch barn from Upstate New York, which survived British raids during the Revolutionary War, is rebuilt into a working, 18th-century grist mill.

programs.title: Restoration Road With Clint Harp
programs.desc: An early 1800s timber-framed barn, part of a rare still-intact early Ohio homestead, is taken down and rebuilt as a timber-framed guest house.
